title: DEVAI framework repository data handling declaration
subject: aarusso-nyx/devai, the framework repository

personal_data.statement: This repository stores no personal data: it holds no application database, no user records, and no data model with personal-data columns; every store below is source, policy, evidence, or state about the software itself.
personal_data.attribution_note: Commit metadata carries the git author identity and role declarations carry a constitutional role name; both are authorship attribution required by Article 41, not personal-data processing by the harness, and the harness never collects, classifies, or exports them as data.

stores.description: Constitution, decision records, schemas, invariants, trace, security declarations, targets, and policy sources.
Owner-authored journeys, use cases, and campaign plans.
Test sources and fixtures; fixtures use synthetic identifiers only.
Materialized policy copies written only by init bind and init apply.
Mutable head state written by executing verbs: counters, task records, bootstrap runner.
Derived inventory and the append-only proof chain of readings, runs, and closures.
Ephemeral working space never committed beyond its README.
